# Declarations

No funding was received to assist with the preparation of this manuscript.

The ADDITION-PRO study was approved by the Scientific Ethics Committee of the Central Denmark Region (reference no. 20080229) and conducted in accordance with the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki.
